description: This file contains Windows-specific logging functions, implementing syslog functionality using Windows Event Log APIs. It defines functions for opening a log connection and writing log entries, including string formatting and message processing.

methods.name: void openlog(const char * ident,int logopt UNUSED,int facility UNUSED)

methods.description: Formats a message with the given priority and message template, handling special substitutions, then logs it to the Windows event log.
